scoring_justification: Full phase diagram simulation is too heavy for verifier sandbox; compare final extracted numbers to reference values digitized from Fig. 3(a).

required.T_t: float, tricritical temperature (reduced units, JC=1.0, kB=1.0)
required.h_t: float, tricritical field amplitude (same reduced units)

outputs.description: The dynamic tricritical point coordinates (T_t, h_t) where the phase boundary changes from second-order to first-order.

required.T_c: float, second-order transition temperature at h=0 (same reduced units)

outputs.description: The zero‑field second‑order critical temperature T_c separating the paramagnetic phase from the ordered phase.

output_contract.notes: Both quantities are fixed deterministic outputs of the simulation for the given Hamiltonian and are scored by absolute‑tolerance comparison against hidden gold values digitised from Fig. 3(a). No directional improvement is defined; exact_match is the appropriate policy.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold tricritical point (T_t, h_t) and critical temperature T_c for r=1.0, Δ_S=0.0
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly traced to paper figure; used as reference tolerance check
